name: Barker Manufacturing Co
old_description: Barker specializes in the custom design and manufacture of RV components, including top-of-the-line
about:
Barker Manufacturing Co. was founded in 1953 by James Barker in Battle Creek, Michigan. The company has remained family-owned and locally operated since its inception, building a reputation for high-quality engineering and craftsmanship in the recreational vehicle market.

The company specializes in the custom design and manufacture of RV components, including Tote-Alongs, power jacks (VIP 3000, VIP 3500, Hi-Power 3500), slidewinders, auto-drains, snaps, VentStiks, fresh water tank kits, fifth-wheel leg levelers, and accessories. Barker also produces custom-designed replacement parts for vintage and older-model RVs. All products are designed and manufactured in-house in the United States.

Barker serves the RV industry, supplying both original equipment manufacturers and aftermarket customers, including individual RV owners seeking replacement parts or vintage components. The company’s product line covers a broad range of RV systems, from leveling and stabilization to water management and ventilation.

Barker emphasizes a commitment to “doing things the right way,” meaning it designs, manufactures, and ships only products it is comfortable putting its name on. The company backs its products with warranties and responsive customer service, positioning its “Made in the USA” heritage as a core differentiator.
